resources.name: FindingAttestation
resources.doc: Assurance consumes the shared assertion; only finding/evaluation bindings live here.

resources.name: AttestationSubject
resources.doc: Typed domain links bind this subject, never a targetType/targetId pair.

resources.name: BillingCharge
resources.doc: Immutable rating result, never a ledger posting or settlement observation.

resources.name: BillingRecurringClaim
resources.doc: One fixed recurring rate per agreement period; retries cannot change its source key.

resources.name: CaseEvent
resources.doc: The journal admits typed facts into the case; raw candidates are inert.

resources.name: CaseInteraction
resources.doc: A bounded engagement within a case; neither the case nor its prescribed workflow.

resources.name: ChallengeApproval
resources.doc: Bind the approval option before votes; option labels never confer authority.

resources.name: DisputeRemedy
resources.doc: Candidate remedy effects never rewrite the challenged record.

resources.name: FulfillmentEnd
resources.doc: Terminal business observation wins over any late execution-start report.

resources.name: FulfillmentExecutor
resources.doc: Executor-specific handle; domain satellites own human/agent/equipment details.

resources.name: FulfillmentTaskLink
resources.doc: Kernel task address, not an application EntityRef or business request payload.

resources.name: SignalMember
resources.doc: Membership and explanation are frozen before the evaluation begins.

resources.name: UsageCorrection
resources.doc: A staged replacement contributes only after this terminal link is committed.

resources.name: UsageDimension
resources.doc: Domain vocabulary fixes one exact unit per dimension; conversion is explicit above.

classification.business: declared domain errors: served, counted separately
classification.counting: one event per logical operation; retries are attempts on the same event, never new events
